description: Land Title Settlement Department - Calling for claims to property of intestate in Homagama D/S Division and other properties
reasoning: This gazette content deals specifically with land and property matters - it's a notice calling for claims to intestate property (property of someone who died without a will) under the Registration of Title Act. The content includes detailed land information such as cadastral map numbers, parcel numbers, land extent measurements, and certificate of title numbers. It involves the settlement of land titles and property ownership claims, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it primarily deals with land registration and property ownership matters.
